forecaster_note: Large S swell with onshore-ish S winds: not much wrap into the sheltered breaks, junky stretches just north of the S corners — a day worth giving a miss. Thu: SW wind starts to clean up the S corners but still overhead and messy. Fri: better-quality SE swell arrives off a Tasman low, well overhead; light W through to mid-arvo. Sat eases slowly, NNW/NW winds texture exposed breaks. — Surfline forecaster (Wed 7 Oct)

wind.summary: S 29 kph (gust 39) cross/onshore at 6am, ~29 kph at 9am, easing to ~26 by 3pm. Backs SW/offshore Thu morning (~13 kph).

shark.summary: Northern Beaches, last 24h: tagged White Shark #2880 detected at North Steyne (Manly) at 5:06pm Tue (~13h ago), and a 1.88m White Shark tagged & released from a SMART drumline at Warriewood at 4:16pm Tue (~14h ago). Nothing at Dee Why, Long Reef or Curl Curl. Feed current (newest statewide activity <1h old; ~38 detections statewide in 24h). Check the live map before paddling out — Manly especially.
